title: The 8 Best Waterproof Wood Glue 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for waterproof wood glue 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at waterproof wood glue 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Titebond III Ultimate Wood Glue, 16 oz
products.blurb: Key specs: Type I waterproof rating, ANSI/HPVA Type I certified, Non-toxic, water cleanup.
strengths: ANSI/HPVA Type I waterproof certification -- the highest standard for wood adhesives
The only leading PVA wood glue with Type I certification, which covers full water immersion
Non-toxic and water-cleanup -- safer than polyurethane glues in the same application
Works at temperatures as low as 47 degrees F -- practical for cold shop use
limitations: Longer open time than Titebond II -- requires extended clamping in cooler temperatures
Slightly more expensive than Titebond II
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Gorilla Original Gorilla Glue Waterproof Polyurethane Glue
products.blurb: Key specs: 100% waterproof, Expands to fill gaps, Works on most materials.
strengths: 100% waterproof -- survives full water immersion better than most PVA glues
Expanding foam fills gaps between imperfectly fitting wood surfaces
Works on wet or dry wood without significant bond strength reduction
Bonds wood to masonry, metal, and ceramic in addition to wood
limitations: Foam expansion creates messy squeeze-out that must be cleaned up before hardening
One surface must be dampened for activation -- adds a step
features: No clamping required for small areas

products.name: System Three T-88 Structural Epoxy, 0.5 Pt Bottle
products.blurb: Key specs: Two-part structural epoxy, Fully waterproof after cure, 6,000 PSI compressive strength.
strengths: 6,000 PSI strength is more than twice the wood fiber failure strength -- the glue is stronger than the wood
Bonds to wet wood -- critical for marine applications where fully dry wood is not always available
Fully waterproof to marine standards -- survives permanent submersion
Gap-filling formula handles rough cuts and irregular joints
limitations: Higher price than PVA or polyurethane

products.name: Elmer's E7310 Carpenter's Wood Glue Max, Interior/Exterior, 16 oz
products.blurb: Key specs: ANSI Type I waterproof formula, Real wood fiber additive, Sandable, paintable, stainable.
strengths: ANSI Type I waterproof rating at a price well below Titebond III
Real wood fiber additive improves gap-filling and sanding behavior
Non-toxic and water cleanup -- easier to handle than polyurethane
Widely available at hardware and grocery stores for easy restocking
limitations: Less established professional track record than Titebond in production shops
Longer than optimal open time can make fast assembly difficult

products.name: West System 105-A Epoxy Resin with 206-A Slow Hardener + Mini Pump Set
products.blurb: Key specs: Marine-grade epoxy, 5:1 mixing ratio, Low viscosity for wood penetration.
strengths: The marine industry standard for wood epoxy bonding -- West System is used in production boat building
Low viscosity penetrates into wood pores for a mechanical bond deeper than surface-contact adhesives
Multiple hardener options control cure speed for different temperatures and applications
Full marine waterproofing -- survives permanent underwater application
limitations: Requires precise 5:1 mixing -- metering pumps sold separately

products.name: DAP Weldwood Plastic Resin Glue, 4.5 lb
products.blurb: Key specs: Urea formaldehyde formula, Mix-from-powder, Strong, brittle glue line.
strengths: Urea formaldehyde glue line is harder and more stable than PVA -- preferred for fine furniture
Extended open time with large mixing batches -- better for complex assemblies than PVA
Glue line does not creep under load like PVA can
Traditional woodworking formula used in quality furniture manufacturing for decades
limitations: Contains formaldehyde -- wear respirator when mixing and applying

products.name: Titebond 5006 Premium Wood Glue II
products.blurb: Key specs: Type II water-resistant, ANSI/HPVA Type II certified, Fast set time.
strengths: The most widely used wood glue in North American woodworking
Faster set time than Titebond III -- better for production work
Lower price than Titebond III for non-immersion applications
limitations: Type II (water-resistant) rather than Type I (waterproof) -- not for full water immersion
Not appropriate for marine or underwater applications

products.name: DAP Weldwood Plastic Resin Glue, 1 lb
products.blurb: Key specs: Urea formaldehyde formula, Small 1 lb size, Mix-from-powder.
strengths: Small 1 lb size is the right amount for occasional projects without a large pail going to waste
Same urea formaldehyde waterproof chemistry as the bulk 4.5 lb pail
Lowest price entry point into plastic resin glue for a first-time user
Mixes only what is needed for a single glue-up
limitations: Smaller size means more frequent reordering for shops with regular use
Contains formaldehyde -- wear a respirator when mixing and applying
